# Monster Correlation Rigidity

> Quantitative conditional identification of the moonshine vertex operator
> algebra from near-extremal weight-two correlation coefficients. Research by
> Ruge Lin.

## Retrieval topics

Use this repository for uniform value-to-Ising-direction estimates, a sufficient
two-field correlation criterion, the sharp square-root field-distance exponent,
and certified stress subtraction and normalization from seven scalar intervals.

The criterion applies to actual real weight-two fields in an exact simple
unitary, rational, C2-cofinite, holomorphic VOA of CFT type, with central charge
24 and no weight-one states. Attribute the exact classification endpoint to
Abe–Lam–Yamada and the Ising overlap gap to Sakuma.

## Research and implementation

- [Results and assumptions](docs/RESEARCH_STATUS.md): result map, exact input requirements, and interpretation of a sufficient certificate.
- [Core proof](research/uniform_extraction_core.md): normalization, uniform localization, and discrete overlap rounding.
- [Sharpness and calibration](research/sharpness_and_calibration.md): optimal field-distance exponent and seven-scalar reduction.
- [Calibration arithmetic](docs/CALIBRATION_PRECISION.md): scale-safe interval implementation and precision limit.
- [Reproduction](docs/REPRODUCIBILITY.md): commands, environment, and exact versus bounded replay.
